jobs_results.title: Test Automation Specialist
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a skilled Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a Test Automation Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated tests to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. This role will primarily focus on performance testing
• *Key Responsibilities:**

- Develop and implement automated test scripts for performance testing.

- Utilize tools such as SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium (for Java background), or Cypress

(for JavaScript background) to conduct automated testing.

- Collaborate closely with development teams to support the creation of Acceptance Criteria and

ensure alignment with testing objectives.

- Demonstrate proficiency in database concepts and possess SQL skills to validate data integrity

during testing processes.

- Leverage Java background to enhance test automation frameworks and contribute to codebase

improvements.

- Optionally, utilize experience with development in Java... knowledge of OpenShift, and familiarity

with microservices architecture to provide additional support and insights.
• *Qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- Proven experience in test automation with a focus on performance testing.

- Proficiency in using tools such as SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, Selenium and Cypress.

- Strong understanding of Acceptance Criteria and ability to translate them into automated test

scenarios.

- Solid knowledge of databases and ability to write and execute SQL queries for testing purposes.

- Experience with Java programming is required; familiarity with additional languages is a plus.

- Optional experience in development with Java, working with OpenShift, and understanding of

microservices architecture is desirable.
• *Skills and Abilities:**

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.

- Ability to adapt to a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

- Self-motivated with a passion for quality assurance and continuous improvement.

If you are a dedicated Test Automation Engineer with a strong background in performance testing, along with proficiency in relevant tools and technologies, we encourage you to apply and be part of our innovative team

jobs_results.title: QA AUTOMATIZACIÓN SELENIUM con FRANCÉS
jobs_results.description:
En Sopra Steria trabajamos para hacer posible la transformación digital de nuestros clientes y para conseguirlo necesitamos seguir creciendo y sumando gracias a personas como tú.

Si quieres trabajar en proyectos internacionales en francés en una multinacional con presencia en más de 30 países y con más de 47.000 colaboradores, ¡Sigue leyendo que tenemos mucho que contarte!

Dentro del plan de expansión y crecimiento de nuestro Centro de Servicios, actualmente precisamos incorporar varios perfiles con buen nivel de francés para el equipo de testing. Seleccionamos para importantes proyectos internacionales en nuestras oficinas, un/a QA Automation Tester (Selenium) con buen nivel de francés.

Porque sabemos lo que necesitas…

· Contrato indefinido

· Facilidades para ti, para tu tiempo. ¡No todo va a ser trabajo!

· Participa en proyectos retadores. ¿Te animas a aprender algo nuevo?

· Crece con un programa de desarrollo continúo personalizado.

· Disfruta de nuestros Beneficios y... accede al Plan de retribución flexible (equipos informáticos, transporte, formación, tickets guardería y seguro médico privado).

· Club del empleado con exclusivos descuentos y ventajas

· Clases de idiomas

· Smart Sessions ¿Tienes algo que contarnos?

¡Y un ambiente de trabajo inmejorable!

En Sopra Steria, apostamos por las personas, por la coherencia y sintonía en los valores básicos de esfuerzo y superación, con voluntad de permanencia a largo plazo. Por ello nuestro mayor activo es la profesionalidad de todos los que desarrollamos nuestra actividad en la compañía.

¡Únete a nosotros, te esperamos

jobs_results.title: QA Automation
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

📢 Business Insights es una empresa de desarrollo de software personalizado para empresas. Estamos viviendo una etapa de crecimiento y queremos incorporar al equipo la figura de un QA AUTOMATION

Creemos en la importancia de la innovación y la creatividad en la creación de soluciones informáticas personalizadas de alta calidad para nuestros clientes. Somos un equipo diverso de ingenieros altamente capacitados y apasionados por la tecnología, que trabajamos juntos para resolver desafíos complejos y mejorar continuamente nuestras habilidades.

Nos gustaría que formes parte de nuestro equipo de desarrollo de software, y estamos seguros de que tu experiencia y habilidades serán una valiosa para nuestra empresa. Te ofrecemos un ambiente de trabajo enriquecedor y colaborativo, donde tendrás la oportunidad de aprender y crecer como desarrollador/a de software mientras trabajas en proyectos interesantes y significativos.

No solo eso, sino que también tendrás la oportunidad de... trabajar con clientes de renombre en diversas industrias, lo que te permitirá adquirir una amplia experiencia en el desarrollo de software y mejorar tus habilidades en la creación de soluciones innovadoras y efectivas.

Requisitos

👉¿Qué necesitamos de tÍ?
• Experiencia +3 años como QA Automation
• Uso de herramientas de automatización de test en desktop y web
• Definir y monitorizar KPIs de pruebas de software y creación de reportes de QA
• Creación de plan de pruebas vinculadas a historias de usuario y poder automatizarlas
• Experiencia en proyectos utilizando Metodología Ágile
• Experiencia en entornos de integración continua
• Uso de GIT
• Postman
• Selenium
• Cucumber
• Cypress

🏆¿Qué esperar estando en nuestro equipo?
• Trabajar en un entorno con diversidad de proyectos estables que te ayudará a crecer profesionalmente
• Contrato Indefinido
• Salario competitivo
• Flexibilidad horaria
• Jornada intensiva en verano

MODALIDAD HIBRIDA! 2 o 3 días en oficina, el resto desde casa

y… ¡ganas de seguir aprendiendo!

🚀 Si te parece bien, inscríbete a la job y nos conocemos!! No esperes más!

Localización

España, Cataluña, Barcelona, 08036

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a de Pruebas Automáticas
jobs_results.description:
Localidad : Torrejón de Ardoz

Provincia : Madrid

País : España

Empresa : Segula Technologies

Nº Vacantes (puestos) : 1

Tipo de oferta : Empleado/a Jornada completa

Descripción

¿Quieres formar parte de una empresa innovadora, presente en sectores tan importantes como automoción, rail, energético o aeroespacial entre otros? Desde SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES estamos buscando a gente como tú. La compañía ha experimentado un rápido crecimiento en los últimos años y actualmente estamos presentes en más de 30 países con más de 15.000 empleados/as. Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida del producto. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES cuenta con un amplio equipo de expertos/as de ingeniería diseño, modelado y simulación, así como tecnologías digitales. Trabajamos en un ambiente inclusivo y respetuoso, donde todas las personas son valoradas y tienen igualdad de oportunidades para desarrollar su potencial.

Funciones

Desde SEGULA Technologies precisamos incorporar en nuestra... plantilla a un/a Ingeniero/a de Pruebas Automáticas para formar parte de un importante proyecto.

Requisitos
• Experiencia en automatización de pruebas.
• Conocimientos amplios en tecnologías para automatización de pruebas (jenkins, robotfwk, pytest-BDD).
• Conocimientos de framework de pruebas (Junit, TestFX y QF-Test)
• Conocimientos en sistemas de control de versiones (Git, bitbucket).
• Conocimientos en el uso de Jira para la gestión documental y el uso de datos.
• Conocimientos en BBDD (no relacionales y relacionales).
• Conocimientos de programación con java, javafx, python, shell-scripting, bash.
• Nivel de Inglés alto.

Se ofrece
• Salario en función de valía y experiencia aportada por el candidato.
• Formación continua.
• Buen ambiente de trabajo: profesional y muy especializado.
• Posibilidad de trabajar en una empresa multinacional en pleno crecimiento a nivel nacional e internacional.
• Promoción interna según tus propios objetivos.
• Posibilidad de obtener ventajas fiscales en tu salario con SEGULA BENEFITS

jobs_results.title: Test Automation Engineer Java (w/m)
jobs_results.description:
We are Deutsche Telekom IT Spain, located in a digital, scientific, and cultural hub of Spain - Valencia.

We work as part of T-Systems Iberia though with a separate structure and projects. Our team is growing, and we are looking forward to meeting more talented employees.

With our highly skilled engineers and experts, we are committed to continue developing the culture of creativity and agility, foster innovations, and be an international tech center!

We are looking for an experienced test engineer with test automation skills to join a scrum based agile development team in our Gigabit project.

In close co-operation with the SW teams your focus is on testing the products on integration level, supporting our QA goals by determining the required overarching test chains, implementing and executing them and as well analysing their results. You drive our test automation to further eliminate manual testing.

You will get the chance to join as a member of an existing international... specialist team. So beside enjoying the test challenges you should as well be excited by the chance to work in an international environment.

The official project communication and backlog description is in English. Specific roles like Product Owners, Product Manager, Solution Engineers, Architects, etc. in your network are mainly located in Germany. You will have the chance to travel internationally, for instance for your onboarding into the team.

📒What tasks we have:

· Plan, implement and execute tests in accordance with test strategy

· Creation of Test Automation using Java + Selenium Framework

· Analyze test execution results

· Maintenance of automated tests in GitLab CI pipeline

· Evaluation of product quality in accordance with requirements for a feature

We expect from candidate:

· Work experience in test automation: 2-3 years

· Solid knowledge of Java

· Experience in End to End testing

· Experience in working with locators (xPath, CSS).

· Experience in creating automated tests for UI and REST API

· Experience in working with GitLab CI

· Experience in performance test

· SQL knowledge

· English level – upper-intermediate

🤲What we offer:
• International, positive, dynamic, friendly, and motivated work environment.
• Modern office in the city centre.
• Flexible working schedule, fully remote or hybrid.
• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.

And many more advantages of being part of Deutsche Telekom IT

jobs_results.description:
Desde la división de IT de Walters People estamos ayudando a uno de nuestros clientes finales, del sector automotriz, en la búsqueda de un Quality Assurance con al menos 3-4 años de experiencia en testing automatizado

Nuestro cliente quiere incrementar el equipo tecnológico con la incorporación de un Quality Assurance en sus oficinas de Madrid con flexibilidad de teletrabajo

Entre sus funciones estará:

Looking for a Test Automation Engineer with a previous experience with Selenium, Appium or Cypress to take ownership of test automation projects and join the global team.

Check out this video to get to know us better: https://youtu.be/Y8I4buoYVKw

We want to hire you, if:
• You are passionate about software quality
• You have at least 2 year's worth of experience with test automation
• You have had previous experience with Selenium, Cypress and/ or Appium
• You are familiar with the concept of CI/CD
• You are proficient in at least one scripting language
• You communicate well in English in both spoken and written form
• You're open to occasional business trips

You can expect to:
• Access Expertise: Utilize TestDevLab's Center of Excellence - knowledge database and a reference hub for the organization's operations
• Innovate with Us: Join our R&D-focused company, shaping TestDevLab's future through innovation
• Mentorship & Teaching: Share your expertise, mentor, and teach
•... Creative Culture: Encourage creativity, share ideas, and be part of our difference-making culture
• Active Lifestyle: Promote work-life balance with sponsored team sports activities
• International environment and projects: Work with colleagues from around the world and gain experience on international projects
• Flexibility: Manage your work life effectively with flexible hours
• Team Building: Team building events to connect with your colleagues and build relationships
• Business Trips: As the occasions arise, you can partake in valuable experiences and broaden your horizons and experience
• Parental Support: Receive a one-time newborn parental bonus for family responsibilities
•

100861-Test Automation Engineer

Test Automation Engineer

Madrid I Hybrid

APPLY

Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Modernes Büro

Mitarbeiterrabatte

Internationale Projekte

Weiterbildung

Our client is a renowned multinational company within the chemical industry. With more than 100,000 employees worldwide, they are now taking it to the next level by enhancing their top-notch Digital Hub in Madrid, which supports their business in many crucial ways.

This role will focus on the modernization of legacy systems and development of new capabilities of digital solutions in the Operational EHS domain. There is a growing global need within the company to leverage digitalization to continue its journey of EHS excellence and continuously improving our capabilities especially through digitalization.

In this role, you will work alongside a global development team to create and iteratively improve upon a global, internal full stack development solution for the... occupational safety domain with a focus on an open source stack and a cloudbased platform

Your responisbilities:
• You will design and develop programs that will test the accuracy and reliability of internally developed software solutions for each module during its initial development and on an ongoing basis, especially in advance of major updates/deployments.
• You will collaborate with members of the Operational EHS Solutions team to define test cases and ensure testing is comprehensive and accurate.
• You will provide feedback to the full-stack developer team, and provide recommendations for corrective approaches for any issues identified during the testing process.
• As a test automation engineer for the Operational EHS Platform and Integration team, you will be part of a global, multidisciplinary team responsible for the development of an internal platform for daily use globally at the company´s production facilities.

Your profile:
• More than 3+ years leading a test automation process for a large team.
• Experience in development and testing, with programming skills in Java, or Javascript.
• Experience in test automation UI / API test development, utilizing design patterns and automation framework such as Selenium Webdriver, Appium, Karate, Rest Assured, JUnit, etc.
• Solid understanding of QA methodologies, including planning and strategy design.
• Be able to speed up the deliverables by preventing bugs and finding bugs faster, creating a QA strategy and solutions for early feedback.
• Experience leading and mentoring QA methodologies.
• Experience in test design, performance testing, test architecture, and configuration management.
• Great communication skills in English

Your benefits:
• Flexible working hours and home-office options
• International team with diverse backgrounds, where respect, support and openness are key
• Stimulating projects and opportunities for personal growth
• Relocation package, private health care insurance, training and courses, transport and restaurant tickets, etc.
• Average of 30 vacation days per year: 23 days per agreement + 5 days of adjustment for possible overtime compensation + 2 days cultural festivities
• Attractive compensation and social benefits package

If you are interested in this challenging position we are looking forward to receiving your comprehensive application for ref.no. 100,861 preferably through our ISG career portal or via email.

Visit isg.com/jobs/search - here you can find new job offers every day.
